result:
Honestly?

I wouldn't make everyone happy. Or peaceful, or rich, or even healthy - as much as I wish I could.

If I could change one thing, I would take away our ability to dehumanize each other.

That reflex where another person - or animal, or living thing - stops being real to us and becomes just an abstraction, a label, a problem, an enemy, a tool. All the worst things we do to each other come from that moment.

I wouldn't force everyone to love each other. Not forced empathy, not mind control. Just - you couldn't look at another being and *not* feel, on some quiet level, "oh, that's someone. That's a life as real as mine."

I think so much cruelty comes from fear and disconnection, and so much fear comes from feeling alone and unseen ourselves. If that illusion of separateness was gone, I think a lot of the rest would slowly untangle on its own.

We'd still disagree. We'd still have pain and grief and hard choices. But we couldn't be casual about causing it.

What about you? If you had the one change?
